title: Joule Sous Vide Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=joule:cook
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by protein_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Joule sous vide session data has stopped arriving for a given protein.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per protein and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It helps you when one part of your Joule sous vide session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
